dashboard.title: Which dashboard?
dashboard.description:
Pick the dashboard to publish.

Tip: create one just for the public, with only what strangers may see. Only dashboards you have saved at least once appear here.

path.title: Public address
path.description:
This is the address you will share. Visitors open it with **no login**:

**{base_url}/**`public-path`

For example, with `solar` the page will be at `{base_url}/solar`.

Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, with no hyphen: that way it can never clash with one of your dashboards.

view.title: Which view?
view.description:
A dashboard can have several views: the tabs at the top of **{dashboard}**. Only **one** of them becomes public; the others stay private.

Pick the view to publish.

error.invalid_path: Use 2-48 characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscores only (no hyphen).
error.path_reserved: That path is reserved by Home Assistant.
error.path_in_use: That path already belongs to a panel or dashboard. Choosing it would hide part of your Home Assistant.

abort.no_dashboards: No dashboard has a saved configuration yet. Create a dashboard, add cards, save it, then set this up.

init.title: Public Access settings
init.description: Your dashboard is published through Home Assistant's own frontend, live and read-only: visitors see exactly the view you chose and cannot change anything. Changing the public path takes effect after a Home Assistant restart.

data.view_path: View to publish (a tab of the dashboard)
data.public_path: Public path (the part after your Home Assistant address)
data.noindex: Ask search engines not to index it
data.loading_background: Loading screen colour (hex, e.g. #111111; empty = Home Assistant default)

error.license_refused: The license server refused this key: {reason}
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the license server. Check that Home Assistant has internet access and try again.

error.path_reserved: That path is reserved by Home Assistant.
error.path_in_use: That path already belongs to a panel or dashboard.

restart_required.title: Restart to finish moving the public dashboard
restart_required.description: The public path changed to {new}, but {old} stays active until Home Assistant restarts, because a route cannot be removed at runtime.
